opening-0.text: Saint Ann, Jamaica, seventeen seventy-two. In this story, a dry season.
opening-0.caption: St Ann, Jamaica, 1772. In this story, a dry season.

opening-6.text: Doctor Hutton's cattle pen. The pond is cracked mud.
opening-6.caption: Dr Hutton’s cattle pen. The pond is cracked mud.

opening-12.text: The road runs west over the dry limestone hills.
opening-12.caption: The road runs west over the dry limestone hills.

opening-17.text: Two miles off, on a rise: Edinburgh Castle.
opening-17.caption: Two miles off, on a rise: Edinburgh Castle.

opening-24.text: A pack mule comes down that road. No rider.
opening-24.caption: A pack mule comes down that road. No rider.

opening-32.text: People say travellers go missing up there.
opening-32.caption: People say travellers go missing up there.

towers-0.text: Dusk. Sampson's cart comes up the castle road.
towers-0.caption: Dusk. Sampson’s cart comes up the castle road.

towers-6.text: Edinburgh Castle stands on its rise over the road.
towers-6.caption: Edinburgh Castle stands on its rise over the road.

towers-12.text: Two storeys of rough stone. A round tower at two corners.
towers-12.caption: Two storeys of rough stone. A round tower at two corners.

towers-19.text: Small square loopholes in the walls. Holes to shoot through.
towers-19.caption: Small square loopholes in the walls. Holes to shoot through.

towers-26.text: One upper window has shutters. Tonight they are shut.
towers-26.caption: One upper window has shutters. Tonight they are shut.

towers-31.text: Below the house, the well still gives water.
towers-31.caption: Below the house, the well still gives water.

towers-37.text: Sampson stops behind the long wall.
towers-37.caption: Sampson stops behind the long wall.

search-0.text: Later that morning. The house is silent.
search-0.caption: Later that morning. The house is silent.

search-4.text: Sampson's cart takes John Callendar home.
search-4.caption: Sampson’s cart takes John Callendar home.

search-9.text: He lies still, under a sheet.
search-9.caption: He lies still, under a sheet.

search-15.text: Nobody from the house comes out.
search-15.caption: Nobody from the house comes out.

search-22_5.text: Days later, Captain Reid comes up the road.
search-22_5.caption: Days later, Captain Reid comes up the road.

search-27_5.text: Hector, enslaved here, goes down to meet him.
search-27_5.caption: Hector, enslaved here, goes down to meet him.

search-38_5.text: The house is empty. He has run.
search-38_5.caption: The house is empty. He has run.

warrant-0.text: Morning. The house stands on its rise over the road.
warrant-0.caption: Morning. The house stands on its rise over the road.

warrant-4.text: John Callendar walks up the track.
warrant-4.caption: John Callendar walks up the track.

warrant-12.text: His jackass is in the castle yard. He calls out. Nobody answers.
warrant-12.caption: His jackass is in the castle yard. He calls out. Nobody answers.

warrant-22_5.text: One shot. The birds go up from the cotton tree.
warrant-22_5.caption: One shot. The birds go up from the cotton tree.

warrant-28.text: A hat lies on the track.
warrant-28.caption: A hat lies on the track.

warrant-32.text: A sick man in the house has seen. He slips out by the east door to tell.
warrant-32.caption: A sick man in the house has seen. He slips out by the east door to tell.

morning-0.text: Spanish Town. The sixteenth morning of March, seventeen seventy-three.
morning-0.caption: Spanish Town. The sixteenth morning of March, 1773.

morning-7.text: King's House is dark. The square is full before the sun is up.
morning-7.caption: King’s House is dark. The square is full before the sun is up.

morning-14.text: Everyone looks one way, down the street.
morning-14.caption: Everyone looks one way, down the street.

morning-20.text: At its end, a frame of timber.
morning-20.caption: At its end, a frame of timber.

morning-27.text: Their sentence, pride, and malice I defy, Despise their power and like a Roman die.
morning-27.caption: “Their sentence, pride, and malice I defy, / Despise their power and like a Roman die.”

morning-34.text: His words. His stone was never made.
morning-34.caption: His words. His stone was never made.

morning-38.text: The court tried him for one killing. No other was ever tried.
morning-38.caption: The court tried him for one killing. No other was ever tried.
